title: Integer to Bit Converter
text: 将整数向量映射为位向量，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Output data type} 指定输出数据类型 Inherit via internal；{Number of bits per integer(M)} 指定每个整数的位数、{Treat input values as} 指定将输入值视为、{Output bit order} 输出位顺序 MSB，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 integer | column vector of integers

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 bit scalar | column vector of bits

params.name: Number of bits per integer(M)
params.values: 每个整数的位数 3 (default) | integer in the range [1, 32]

params.name: Treat input values as
params.values: 将输入值视为 Unsigned (default) | Signed

params.name: Output bit order
params.values: 输出位顺序 MSB first (default) | LSB first

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | Same as input | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean
